mapper.select: SELECT cc.COLLECTION_ID, cc.COLLECTION_NO, cc.COLLECTION_PERIOD, cc.COST_CENTER_ID, ccc.CENTER_NAME as COST_CENTER_NAME, cc.COLLECTION_TYPE, CASE cc.COLLECTION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN '直接成本' WHEN 2 THEN '间接成本' WHEN 3 THEN '制造费用' ELSE '未知' END as COLLECTION_TYPE_NAME, cc.COLLECTION_AMOUNT, cc.COLLECTION_STATUS, CASE cc.COLLECTION_STATUS WHEN 1 THEN '待归集' WHEN 2 THEN '归集中' WHEN 3 THEN '已归集' WHEN 4 THEN '已审核' ELSE '未知' END as COLLECTION_STATUS_NAME, cc.COLLECTION_METHOD, CASE cc.COLLECTION_METHOD WHEN 1 THEN '手工归集' WHEN 2 THEN '自动归集' ELSE '未知' END as COLLECTION_METHOD_NAME, TO_CHAR(cc.COLLECTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as COLLECTION_DATE, cc.AUDITOR_ID, cc.AUDITOR_NAME, cc.AUDIT_TIME, cc.AUDIT_REMARK, cc.BOOK_ID, cc.TENANT_ID, cc.REMARK, cc.CREATE_TIME, cc.UPDATE_TIME, cc.CREATOR, cc.UPDATER FROM "REDACTED"."T_COST_COLLECTION" cc LEFT JOIN "REDACTED"."T_COST_CENTER" ccc ON cc.COST_CENTER_ID = ccc.CENTER_ID WHERE cc.COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND cc.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT cd.DETAIL_ID, cd.COLLECTION_ID, cd.COST_ELEMENT_CODE, cd.COST_ELEMENT_NAME, cd.VOUCHER_ID, cd.VOUCHER_NO, cd.ACCOUNT_CODE, cd.ACCOUNT_NAME, cd.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT, cd.ALLOCATION_RATE, cd.ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.PROJECT_NAME, cd.BUSINESS_TYPE, cd.REMARK FROM "REDACTED"."T_COST_COLLECTION_DETAIL" cd WHERE cd.COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND cd.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY cd.DETAIL_ID
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_COST_COLLECTION ( COLLECTION_ID, COLLECTION_NO, COLLECTION_PERIOD, COST_CENTER_ID, COLLECTION_TYPE, COLLECTION_AMOUNT, COLLECTION_STATUS, COLLECTION_METHOD, COLLECTION_DATE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR, VERSION, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{collectionId}, #{collectionNo}, #{collectionPeriod}, #{costCenterId}, #{collectionType}, #{collectionAmount}, 1, #{collectionMethod},
TO_DATE(#{collectionDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
NULL
, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{remark}, SYSDATE, #{creatorId}, 1, 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE T_COST_COLLECTION SET COLLECTION_STATUS = #{collectionStatus},
COLLECTION_AMOUNT = #{collectionAmount},
COLLECTION_DATE = TO_DATE(#{collectionDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updaterId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0

UPDATE T_COST_COLLECTION SET COLLECTION_STATUS = #{collectionStatus}, AUDITOR_ID = #{auditorId}, AUDITOR_NAME = #{auditorName}, AUDIT_TIME = #{auditTime}, AUDIT_REMARK = #{auditRemark}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updaterId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
UPDATE T_COST_COLLECTION SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updaterId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_COST_COLLECTION_DETAIL ( DETAIL_ID, COLLECTION_ID, COST_ELEMENT_CODE, COST_ELEMENT_NAME, VOUCHER_ID, VOUCHER_NO, ACCOUNT_CODE, ACCOUNT_NAME, ORIGINAL_AMOUNT, ALLOCATION_RATE, ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, DEPARTMENT_NAME, PROJECT_NAME, BUSINESS_TYPE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, VERSION, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{detailId}, #{collectionId}, #{costElementCode}, #{costElementName}, #{voucherId}, #{voucherNo}, #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{originalAmount}, #{allocationRate}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{departmentName}, #{projectName}, #{businessType}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{remark}, SYSDATE, 1, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_COST_COLLECTION_DETAIL SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
